name: Lot
bio:
Lot is the son of Haran and nephew of Abraham. After his father Haran died in Ur, Lot followed his grandfather Terah and uncle Abram as the family migrated, and later followed Abram out of Haran into Canaan, becoming one of the closest family members in Abraham's early journey (Genesis 11:27-31; 12:4-5).

As both men's flocks and servants grew, strife broke out between Lot's herdsmen and Abram's, so Abram let Lot choose his own territory; Lot, drawn by the lushness of the Jordan plain, chose to move toward Sodom, gradually drawing close to that city of great sin (Genesis 13). Before Sodom was destroyed by God, Lot escaped with his two daughters through Abraham's intercession and the rescue of God's angels, though his wife looked back and became a pillar of salt (Genesis 19). Lot's story stands as an important biblical warning about the dangers of being drawn to the world and choosing where to live by its allure.
